allow: Bash(Rscript -e 'cat\("R version:", R.version$major, ".", R.version$minor, "\\n"\); cat\("Library paths:\\n"\); cat\(paste0\("  ", .libPaths\(\), collapse="\\n"\), "\\n"\); pkgs <- c\("DBI", "duckdb", "readxl", "readr", "dplyr", "data.table", "tibble"\); status <- sapply\(pkgs, function\(p\) requireNamespace\(p, quietly=TRUE\)\); cat\("\\nPackage availability:\\n"\); for\(p in names\(status\)\) cat\(sprintf\("  %s: %s\\n", p, ifelse\(status[p], "OK", "MISSING"\)\)\)')
